prompt:
Create one high-fidelity desktop web application screenshot for an Advanced Databases assignment prototype. Landscape 1440x960 viewport, no browser chrome. It must look like a usable CRUD catalogue, not a poster, concept artwork, collage, or promotional landing page. No photos, no logos, no invented business claims. Do not invent any IDs, dates, counts, metrics, stock values, category names, or fields.

Visual direction: “Specimen Register”, inspired by museum accession registers and specimen-label hierarchy, translated into a contemporary digital product catalogue. The metaphor contributes careful record indexing, label hierarchy, and inspectable field/value structure only; do not add accession numbers or museum-specific data. Cool matte record surfaces in pale gray #F2F5F7, deep blue-black #18252D, cobalt #2457F5 used only for actionable controls and selected state, and a tiny chartreuse #D7EF62 used only for a status marker. Workhorse system sans-serif for interface copy and monospaced type for numeric values and JSON. No serif, no cream, no terracotta, no glass, no glow, no decorative grain.

Composition: slim top header with exact text “Product catalogue”, a small “Sample data” marker, and a cobalt “Add product” button. Below, a quiet label “Catalogue records” and one two-pane workspace: a product index at left (about 53% width) and the selected record inspector at right (about 47%). At the top of the index, show a labeled search field and category dropdown. Four visible rows, with exact content:
Samsung Galaxy A15 | Phones | ZMW 2,800 | Stock 14 | In stock
Tecno Spark 20 | Phones | ZMW 2,100 | Stock 22 | In stock
iPhone 13 | Phones | ZMW 11,500 | Stock 4 | Low stock
Cotton T-Shirt | Clothing | ZMW 150 | Stock 60 | In stock
Select Samsung Galaxy A15. Do not show any extra IDs or invented rows. Each record row is a precise printed-register band, not a raised card.

The right inspector title reads “Samsung Galaxy A15” and “Edit product”. Show actual labeled inputs Name, Category, Price (ZMW), Stock, Tags, Specs, with exact values:
Name Samsung Galaxy A15; Category Phones; Price 2800; Stock 14; Tags android and budget; Specs storage 128GB, ram 4GB, battery 5000mAh.
Show clear Save product and Cancel actions, plus a restrained Delete action. Below the form, show “MongoDB document” and a clear read-only nested document with exactly these fields and values: name, category, price, stock, tags, specs. No ObjectId field, no timestamp, no invented metadata. Keep the form, document, and product index visibly connected by a consistent label grid. Strictly accurate copy and values. Excellent contrast, readable spacing, sharp controls, no nested cards.
